notes.title: 🏂 Get a new point of view with the free update 🏂
notes.notes:
Hello Mountain Lovers,

A new update for Grand Mountain Adventure: Wonderlands is now available for free! You can now change your point of view between Front and Behind Cameras with just the press of a button, so that you can enjoy the mountains ⛰️ like never before!

https://youtu.be/teRQ0DCL4gY

📬 Stay connected!

notes.title: Steam Fest Livestream and demo update
notes.notes:
Hello riders, 

Interested in seeing the team behind Grand Mountain Adventures: Wonderland play their game? Meet us today at 6h45pm CET/9H45am PST for a livestream showcasing our winterly adventure. We would love to answer all of your questions!

Some of you might have already noticed a small patch for the demo, we know some players encountered a black-screen issue we are trying to fix it, hopefully before this stream ːwinter2019happydogː

And another new update: GMA: Wonderlands now supports 4 instead of 2 controllers connected at the same time. Which is awesome when playing remotely with friends

stay safe and see you on the ski tracks ːwinter2019joyfultearssnowmanː
